name: question headline over a soft gradient wash
looks: A two-line question fades up and scales in gently on a soft warm-to-cool gradient field, its second line in the accent colour. A row of small feature words (one per capability) fades in beneath it in one quiet beat, dimming toward the edge.
build: aurora-gradient-photo for the background wash (slow drifting diagonal gradient with grain); the headline keys in on a short scale-and-fade (0.95 -> 1, opacity 0 -> 1) on power2.out; the word row fades in together about 0.3 s behind it.
sound: A soft pad swell under the headline.
prompt: Open on a two-line question that fades and scales gently into frame over a soft drifting gradient wash, its final word in the accent colour. Let a short row of small capability words fade in beneath it a beat later, quiet and unhurried, to set up what the film will show.
